categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Zhimingda Electronics Co., Ltd primarily operates in the design, development, production, and sales of customized embedded computer modules and solutions. Its products serve key national defense sectors including airborne, missile-borne, naval, vehicle-mounted, satellite, and unmanned equipment embedded systems. The company focuses on embedded computing modules for radar, communication, navigation, electronic warfare, flight control, and other critical defense applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary embedded computing technologies including embedded real-time operating systems, FPGA-based hardware customization, multi-core parallel processing, high-speed data buses, image perception and intelligent processing, inertial navigation signal acquisition, and high-reliability power supplies. Production follows a customized make-to-order model with a combination of in-house manufacturing and outsourced processing, emphasizing rigorous quality control and compliance with defense-grade reliability and environmental standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are major state-owned defense groups and their affiliated research institutes, including China Electronics Technology Group, China Aviation Industry Group, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, and China Ordnance Industry Group. The end markets are national defense sectors focusing on airborne platforms (aircraft), missile systems, naval vessels, ground vehicles, satellites, and unmanned systems, reflecting a strong orientation towards military and aerospace embedded computing applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Its customer base is concentrated in domestic national defense and aerospace sectors, serving key state-owned enterprises and government research institutions across the country.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhimingda operates in the midstream segment of the embedded computing supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of embedded computer modules and systems that are integrated into larger defense and aerospace platforms. It procures electronic components and integrated circuits from upstream suppliers and delivers customized modules to downstream system integrators and equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in embedded computing technologies, focusing on next-generation avionics buses, ultra-high-speed inter-board communication, image perception with AI processing, inertial navigation signal acquisition, and high-reliability power supplies. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining a robust pipeline of over 190 new projects annually, and emphasizes domestic technology development and product localization to enhance competitiveness and meet evolving defense requirements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized embedded computer modules and integrated solutions to national defense customers. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with revenue recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to strategic projects and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with large state-owned defense enterprises and affiliated research institutes that have long-standing experience and scale advantages in embedded computing for defense applications. As a leading private enterprise in this sector, Zhimingda differentiates itself through rapid technology updates, flexible management, cost advantages, and strong customer service, positioning itself as a key emerging player in China's defense embedded computing market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Zhimingda reported revenues of approximately RMB 663 million, representing a 22.58% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 96.26 million, up 27.73%. The company has shown steady growth with expanding order volumes and increasing market penetration in key defense sectors. Its total assets stood at approximately RMB 1.53 billion, with a solid equity base and ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhimingda offers highly reliable, customized embedded computing solutions tailored to the stringent requirements of national defense applications. Its products feature advanced technologies such as multi-core processing, high-speed data exchange, AI-enabled image perception, and robust environmental adaptability. The company emphasizes domestic innovation, cost-effectiveness, and deep integration with customer systems, providing comprehensive embedded solutions that enhance the operational capabilities of critical defense platforms.
